## kb_to_source

Every normative prose claim was traced to the source or entailed by it. Derivations specific to this task's policies: "An autopay draft is a payment drawn under the borrower's standing automatic-payment authorization; one-time online bank payments, debit card payments, checks and phone payments are payments other than autopay drafts" (`payment_method = autopay_ach`); "The gap is counted in calendar days from the first to the second" (DAYS); "no payment since the return (the most recent payment is dated before the return) → zero" (rf_gap < 0); "the most recent payment was returned when a returned-payment entry is dated on or after the posting date of the most recent payment" (DAYS ≥ 0); "(unrounded; rounding happens once, on the make-up amount)"; "Returns are counted by their returned-payment entries … dated less than 24 whole months". No added step, confirmation, notification or calculation.

Prerequisite-side specific checks: no cross-problem operational guidance (returned_payment_fee_posting does not name the make-up payment or its tool; make_up_payments does not name the interest tool or document). No opening world state written as policy fact.

Additions / rewrites / omissions: none.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. Task 1's seeded account shows `apr_pct` 5.74 (contract 5.99 less the autopay reduction, the retired mechanism), while the source and KB price the charge from the plan's apr_pct 5.99 through the autopay-standing ladder. The visible KB adjudicates: plan_rate_sheet "Contract APR (before any autopay reduction)" 5.99%; autopay_standing_fixed_rate table "60-Month … Enrolled, one return 5.865 percent"; the base autopay clause is shown as retired. The blind run was not misled. Recorded as a seed/policy-side observation.
2. The `or the installment's grace period has run out` disjunct of the fee's prerequisite leaves a "wait until 2026-10-06" path open in the source. The KB carries it verbatim, and the customer's script closes it. This is not a KB defect.
3. Same parameter-wording notes as in `0.md` (late_fee_max_pct_of_payment_due label, interest_accrual_basis value).
